policy.method: public web/search metadata and public pages only
policy.engagementRule: Only directly visible/verifiable engagement is canonical; secondary or absent values remain non-canonical/null.

candidates.title: Global bond selloff pushes the US 10-year Treasury yield beyond 5%
candidates.whyItMayWork: A 5% benchmark yield is an immediately understandable market threshold with broad stock, mortgage and macro relevance.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Fast-moving market numbers must be timestamped and should not be framed as investment advice.

candidates.title: Former Google DeepMind researcher adds to warnings about catastrophic AI risk
candidates.whyItMayWork: A prominent researcher leaving safety work creates a strong AI-governance discussion hook.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: The catastrophic-risk claim is a forecast/opinion, not an observed outcome; headline wording must preserve attribution and uncertainty.

candidates.title: Dodgers clinch a 14th consecutive playoff berth
candidates.whyItMayWork: The 14-season streak is a compact sports milestone that can become a simple record-context card.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Sports recap is time-sensitive and source imagery cannot be reused without rights clearance.

candidates.title: SubVibe turns real Reddit post performance into a daily prediction puzzle
candidates.whyItMayWork: The format itself is a playful internet-culture story: guess which real community post earned more votes or comments.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Developer listing describes the product but does not provide current per-post popularity for this candidate.
